ops.text: open-pr pr-watcher (<=0.6.3) armed a Monitor when spawned as a background subagent; Monitor is accepted there but its events never wake a subagent, so the watch died the moment the agent ended its turn (ship-ria-413, monorepo #41342/#41344 on Oct 20). Its foreground PR_POLL_WINDOW=40 path only triggered on Monitor refusal. Fixed in yasyf/cc-skills#536 (open-pr 0.6.4): foreground poll is the only path, Monitor/TaskStop dropped from tools.
